hypothesis.statement: A conformed MetaHuman head is not suitable for an interactive AI assistant until it has a facial rig with blendshapes and high-resolution texture sources, and a returned cloud request alone does not prove those assets exist.
hypothesis.action: Bind blocking UE 5.6 MetaHuman Cloud auto-rig and texture requests to the P31 receipt, request JOINTS_AND_BLENDSHAPES, preserve an immutable receipt, and leave all asset-verification flags false for a separate evidence stage.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Cloud work is repeatable and lineage-safe without turning authentication, HTTP return or partial output into a false production claim.

officialApi.authentication: Epic account with MetaHuman Cloud access

failureHandling: reject P31 job or receipt checksum drift
reject unconformed or overclaimed P31 state
save only after both calls return
treat returned calls as awaiting verification, not proof of assets
never mark rig, blendshapes or texture sources verified in the request receipt
decision: Proceed to separate asset verification in P33; do not assemble or advertise a character based only on cloud request return.
